title: Advanced Wreck Diving at USNS General Hoyt S. Vandenberg
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: The USNS General Hoyt S. Vandenberg, a retired Air Force missile tracking ship, lies 160 feet beneath the waves, offering advanced certified divers an unparalleled underwater adventure. Explore its expansive 520-foot structure, where vibrant coral and diverse marine life thrive. Navigate through radar dishes, intricate passageways, and expansive decks, all teeming with fish, turtles, and majestic Goliath groupers. This signature dive in Key West promises unforgettable photo opportunities and a chance to witness the beauty of an artificial reef, making it a must for any experienced diver's bucket list.
